lines.1: The day of the Sports and Martial Arts Festival--
lines.2: The students were throwing themselves into fierce athletic competition.
lines.3: Local TV coverage. Aerial footage from helicopters.
lines.4: It was such a major event that even newspapers sometimes came to cover it.
lines.5: Of course, the flashy events were the biggest attraction.
lines.6: But the various services on offer drew plenty of attention too.
lines.7: In front of Ryuumeikan Academy's main gate.
lines.11: I was mixed in with the drama club, helping receive visitors.
lines.12: ...The stream of guests just wouldn't let up.
lines.13: Still, just putting on maid outfits made THIS much difference... Guess the world really runs on buzz.
lines.14: Konoe was the best-looking of the bunch, so people kept talking to her. She looked swamped.
lines.15: 「A little while ago, she chased off some students from another school who were hassling us! Like!」
lines.17: 「I figured that kind of thing was the men's job.」
lines.18: 「Hah. That way of thinking is ancient.」
lines.21: 「...Ah, it's almost time for my event, so I'm stepping out.」
lines.24: Konoe hurried off at a run.
lines.25: Another wave of visitors came pouring in.
